name: envato-r2
description: Search Envato with a user-owned browser session, download licensed assets, and save them to Cloudflare R2.

interface.shortDescription: Find Envato assets, diagnose a saved session, and store licensed downloads in R2
interface.longDescription: Local Codex plugin for operator-approved Envato asset workflows. It launches a browser session you control, searches app.envato.com, downloads assets through the normal Envato UI, and uploads the asset, license certificate when available, and a metadata manifest to a private Cloudflare R2 bucket. Its optional session diagnostic is local-only and never returns cookie or storage values.
defaultPrompt: Use Envato to R2 to check my setup or inspect saved-session evidence
